agents.label: types-acids
agents.task: Types: pka-values (4 worked, 26 practice; kind numeric, one compound each, built from content/tables/pka.json plus close relatives a student must estimate by analogy, such as cyclohexanol, 1-butyne, butane, diisopropylamine, p-cresol, propanoic acid; a few mcq of the form 'which hydrogen is the acidic one'). acid-rank (4 worked, 14 practice; kinds rank and mcq: rank acids or bases and name the deciding factor among induction, size, hybridization, aromaticity, resonance, electronegativity; include the solvent effect on alcohols and the gas-phase reversal). acid-base-eq (4 worked, 14 practice; kinds mcq, numeric and classify: which side an equilibrium favours, K as a power of ten from the two pKa values, which base is strong enough to deprotonate a given acid, why organometallic reagents are destroyed by water). No mechanisms file.

agents.label: types-sn2a
agents.task: Types: nuc-pairs (the types file exists: improve it only if something is missing; 4 worked, 24 practice; kind mcq with layout pair). rate-pairs (5 worked, 24 practice; kind mcq with layout pair whose two choices are [[rxn:…]] reactions that differ in exactly one thing: nucleophile strength or charge, leaving group, substrate class, vinyl or aryl versus alkyl carbon, solvent, concentration for SN2 versus SN1; say in the solution which single thing differs). fastest-substrate (3 worked, 14 practice; kinds mcq and rank: fastest or slowest SN2, SN1 or E2 among three or four substrates, using the lecture's Figure 7.3 numbers; include allyl, vinyl, isobutyl and tert-butyl cases). No mechanisms file.
